name: Next.js Drag-and-Drop Dashboard Demo
summary: Dashboard demo with drop-to-swap drag-and-drop layouts, built with Next.js, shadcn/ui and swapy.
description: A Next.js dashboard where layout blocks can be dragged and swapped, with real-time layout updates and a responsive design. Built with shadcn/ui components and the swapy drag-and-drop library, server-rendered like a normal Next.js app.
